text: Bridge, remember that my German level is A two, and our Berlin food market budget is sixty euros.

High Bridge, Lena and I are exploring a Berlin food market this Saturday. We love vegetarian food. Suggest three fun things we could do with a little excitement.

Hi! Since you and Lena have a budget of sixty euros, you can have a great time. First, try a tasting challenge. Pick three different vegetarian snacks and see which one is the best. Second, look for a local producer and ask them Was ist Ihre Empfehlung? which means What is your recommendation? Third, find a unique vegetable you have never seen before and try to guess its taste before you buy it.
Wait one change. It's going to rain. Give us one indoor idea instead—just two short sentences, please.
Visit a covered market hall like Markthalle Neun to stay dry. You can sample various vegetarian treats while exploring the indoor stalls.
I want to tell Lena. Ich freue mich auf Samstag. Does that sound natural? Explain briefly. Then say the German sentence once.
Yes, that sounds very natural. It means I am looking forward to Saturday. Ich freue mich auf Samstag.
